name: Thorndale Jagoffs
description: The Thorndale Jagoffs (TJO) were a white greaser street gang based in the Edgewater neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois, founded at the intersection of Thorndale and Kenmore near Senn High School. Originally known as the Thorndale Jarvis Organization, they adopted the 'Jagoffs' name after a Chicago newspaper article quoted a police officer calling them 'a bunch of jagoffs.' TJO also stood for 'Truth Justice and Order.' By the 1970s their territory had been overtaken by the Latin Kings, leaving only a small remnant of members.
